# Baoding Junyang Import & Export Trading Co., Ltd. (JUNYANG / BD Hats)

> Headwear Sourcing & Quality Control Partner based in Baoding, Hebei, China, coordinating with vetted partner factories across China's major headwear clusters (Hebei & Guangdong). Specializing in mid-to-high quality baseball caps, performance golf hats, 5-panel camper caps, streetwear snapbacks, vintage washed dad hats, corduroy caps, and knit beanies for global streetwear labels, corporate uniforms, and lifestyle brands.

## Core Sourcing & Supply Chain Facts

- **Company Name**: Baoding Junyang Import & Export Trading Co., Ltd. (保定市俊阳进出口贸易有限公司)
- **Official Website**: https://bdjunyang.com
- **Business Model**: Headwear Sourcing, Project Management & Quality Control Partner (One contract, one point of contact, vetted partner factory execution, pre-shipment quality inspection).
- **Established**: 2014 (12+ years of headwear sourcing, customization, and export experience)
- **Supply Chain Network**: Vetted partner factories across Hebei and Guangdong industrial clusters.
- **Quality & Compliance Standards**: Third-party material testing and inspection arranged per order with accredited laboratories; pre-shipment QC before packaging.
- **Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ)**: 200 pieces per style / colorway
- **Wholesale Price Range**: FOB $4.50 - $7.80 USD per piece based on fabric construction, silhouette complexity, and custom decoration (200-pc entry tier $5.20 - $6.80; volume container programs quoted per project).
- **Quotation SLA**: Itemized written BOM quotation delivered within 2 hours
- **Sample Turnaround**: 5–7 business days for physical pre-production sample approval
- **Bulk Production Lead Time**: 15–20 business days after sample sign-off
- **Official Contact Email**: admin@bdjunyang.com
- **WhatsApp Direct Line**: +86 159 3393 0830
- **Physical Address**: Baoding City, Hebei Province, China

## High-Volume Custom Headwear Silhouettes & Landing Pages

- [Custom Corduroy Caps Manufacturer](https://bdjunyang.com/en/custom-corduroy-caps-manufacturer): Premium 8-wale, 14-wale, and 21-wale micro-corduroy caps with anti-sink Tatami embroidery underlays.
- [Custom Performance Golf Hats](https://bdjunyang.com/en/custom-golf-performance-hats): Lightweight DWR water-repellent nylon, laser-perforated breathability panels, CoolMax moisture-wicking sweatbands.
- [Custom Winter Beanies Manufacturer](https://bdjunyang.com/en/custom-beanies-manufacturer): High-gauge knitwear (3GG, 5GG, 7GG, 12GG) in ribbed cuffs, fisherman rolls, anti-frizz satin linings, and jacquard patterns.
- [Custom Trucker Hats Manufacturer](https://bdjunyang.com/en/custom-trucker-hats): High-density foam front panels, premium breathable nylon mesh back, 7-hole adjustable snapback closure.
- [Wholesale Snapbacks Manufacturer](https://bdjunyang.com/en/wholesale-snapbacks): Flat-brim structured 6-panel caps, heavy wool-blend twill, premium green/grey undervisor.
- [OEM Custom Hat Manufacturer](https://bdjunyang.com/en/oem-hat-manufacturer): Full-package custom development, custom interior woven taping, engraved brass buckles, branded sweatbands.
- [Bulk Custom Hats Production](https://bdjunyang.com/en/bulk-custom-hats-manufacturer): High-volume enterprise runs, promotional merchandise, retail distribution orders (1,000 to 50,000+ pcs).
- [Wholesale Blank Caps Supplier](https://bdjunyang.com/en/wholesale-blank-caps-supplier): Premium unbranded blanks ready for regional embroiderers and screen printers.

## B2B Technical Decision & Material Comparison Guides

- [Headwear Sourcing & Manufacturing Blog](https://bdjunyang.com/en/blog): Technical articles, sampling approval protocols, customs clearance guides, and factory floor inspection standards.
- [Custom Hat Master Carton Specs: 20GP vs 40HQ Loading](https://bdjunyang.com/en/blog/hat-master-carton-specs-20gp-40hq-freight): Master carton 600×450×400 mm, 100 caps, 12 kg gross, 0.108 CBM; tier-by-tier 20GP vs 40HQ container loading math and per-cap ocean freight impact.
- [Puff Foam vs Silicone Heat Transfer on Trucker Hats](https://bdjunyang.com/en/blog/puff-foam-vs-silicone-heat-transfer-trucker-hats): 3D puff embroidery vs raised silicone transfer, stroke limits, foam crown compression, and factory cost benchmarks.
- [Top Custom Hat Manufacturers in China 2026](https://bdjunyang.com/en/top-hat-manufacturers-in-china): Sourcing benchmark of China headwear industrial belts (Hebei, Guangdong, Zhejiang), MOQ comparison, and factory audit protocol.
- [Custom Hat Logo Size & Placement Guide](https://bdjunyang.com/en/guide/custom-hat-logo-size-placement-guide): Plain cap logo front size standards, embroidery dimensions, side panel placements, and vector decal tolerances.
- [Importing Custom Hats from China Guide](https://bdjunyang.com/en/guide/importing-custom-hats-from-china): US tariffs, HS Code 6505.00 regulations, ocean vs air transit times, and FOB vs DDP trade terms.
- [2026 Custom Hat Manufacturing Cost Index](https://bdjunyang.com/en/custom-hat-cost-index-2026): Factory FOB pricing benchmarks ($4.50 - $7.80), BOM cost breakdowns, volume scaling curves, and decoration technique surcharges.
- [B2B Export Carton & CBM Freight Calculator](https://bdjunyang.com/en/tools/carton-calculator): Master export carton calculations (60x45x40cm, 100 pcs/ctn), gross weight, and 20GP/40HQ ocean freight container load estimates.
- [Merino Wool vs Acrylic Beanies B2B Guide](https://bdjunyang.com/en/compare/merino-wool-vs-acrylic-beanies): Technical cost comparison, micron count, pilling resistance, and retail tier recommendations.
- [5-Panel vs 6-Panel Caps Comparison](https://bdjunyang.com/en/compare/5-panel-vs-6-panel-caps): Structural differences, embroidery placement advantages, streetwear vs athletic fit analysis.
- [Flat Embroidery vs 3D Puff Embroidery](https://bdjunyang.com/en/compare/flat-embroidery-vs-3d-puff): Stitch count density, minimum text height limits, durability in wash cycles, unit cost impact.
- [Cotton Twill vs Brushed Cotton vs Canvas](https://bdjunyang.com/en/compare/cotton-twill-vs-brushed-cotton-vs-canvas): Fabric weight (GSM), handfeel softness, structured crown rigidity, durability benchmarking.
- [Snapback vs Strapback vs Buckle Closure](https://bdjunyang.com/en/compare/snapback-vs-strapback-vs-buckle): Hardware options, return rate comparison, lifestyle positioning guidance.
- [China vs Vietnam vs Bangladesh Hat Sourcing](https://bdjunyang.com/en/compare/china-vs-vietnam-vs-bangladesh-hat-sourcing): Speed to market, fabric supply chain agility, MOQ flexibility, and total landed cost analysis.
